summary: Privately owned Noble County tower, registered 2014 as US 1026, OH 15; hosts radio equipment for the Muskingum Watershed Conservancy District; no build history found.

access.note: Register says the tower is privately owned; no source says whether visitors may enter the land or climb it

facts.agency: Private Owner (Chuck Kolb), per the National Historic Lookout Register

events.note: Date registered September 3, 2014 as US 1026, OH 15

evidence.supports: administered by a private owner, Chuck Kolb
privately owned and hosts MWCD radio equipment
evidence.quote: This tower is privately owned and hosts radio equipment for the Muskingum Watershed Conservancy District.

evidence.supports: FFLA list marks the tower as standing
evidence.quote: Senecaville Noble 39.89747 -81.41770 Tower Standing NHLR US 1026, OH 15

notes_for_editor: Read: NHLR Senecaville page (register entry only, no history section); FFLA Ohio list. Eastern lookouts Senecaville page has only the register listing and no history. Two web searches and a Wikipedia check of Senecaville Lake and village pages turned up no history of this tower; the lake page does not mention a lookout. Missing: build date, builder, design, height, fire and staffing history, and visiting information. Story is short because the evidence is thin. Coordinates on the register match the FFLA list (39.897583, -81.417611). Photo credit on the register (Scott Gilmore) not recorded: no image URL was read.
